page.overview:
What is Elfhelm?

|lit=Fairy Homeland}} was the home of the elves, a paradisaical kingdom located on the island of Skellig in the Western Sea. Like Flora's spirit tree mansion, it lay in the Interstice before the Great Wave of the Astral World. Many magic users resided in a hamlet within the domain's border, living alongside the elves and their ruler, the Flower Storm Monarch, with a variety of other mystical creatures.

Elfhelm was an unmapped, peaceful paradise where food was plentiful, housing cherries that spontaneously regrew upon being plucked, and a populace that played every day. In the center of Elfhelm lied a gargantuan cherry blossom tree which acted as a palace for the domain's ruler: the Flower Storm Monarch.

One feature unique to the island and nearby domains (such as coves) was that its flow of time was different to the outside world. Also atypical were the trees of the Flower Storm Monarch's demesne; they were extremely large, but did not prevent light from permeating below, as if they themselves emanated light.

Though the land itself was not inherently harmful, many enchantments were placed around it to keep outsiders away following the Great Wave of the Astral World and the realm's subsequent sublimation into the Physical World. One such enchantment resulted in the outsider thinking themselves to be walking in a straight line, but eventually finding themselves back where they started. Only natives were unaffected by the barrier and could navigate through it. In addition, a magic pumpkin patch laden with scarecrows surrounded Elfhelm. The scarecrows attacked any intruders if the produce was touched, and even the pumpkins themselves could be enchanted with the power of gnomes – spirits of the earth – by witches as a method of driving away trespassers.
